item.title: The stock market is a powerful wealth-building tool
item.description: The stock market is a powerful wealth-building tool and you should be investing in it. But realize the market and the value of your shares will sometimes drop dramatically. This is absolutely normal and to be expected. When it happens, ignore the drops and buy more shares. This will be much, much harder than you think. People all around you will panic. The news media will be screaming Sell, Sell, Sell!

item.title: Puppy Money Summary
item.description: There are some people reading this who can't listen to what you have to say, and nothing changes. Others start to manage money wisely after reading it, and they will have a happier and richer life.
item.content:encoded:
理财的基础

财务自由是今天每个人都可能实现的目标，当然这需要我们拥有追求自己真正想要的生活的勇气。正如一句名言所说：“并非困难使我们放弃，而是因为我们放弃，才显得如此困难。”

将金钱的规律铭记在心，我们就会发现自己的财务状况在日益改善。没有任何东西能够阻挡一个顺应时势的想法。这一点也适用于每一个人的生活。什么都无法阻挡我们享受自己与生俱来的权利——富裕。富有尊严、财务上游刃有余的生活符合我们的自然法则。只要我们不放弃，那就没有任何东西可以阻碍我们达到这个目标。

做一本梦想相册

想要实现财务自由，我们必须有驱动力。因此，我们首先要做的就是想出我们想要变富有的 10 个理由（愿望）把它写下来。这会是我们行动的动力。

然后，在这 10 个想要变富有的理由当中选出最重要的 3 个，不要给自己太多的目标，这样不现实。人的欲望是无穷无尽的，我们需要分清主次，分清哪些才是最重要的目标。确定了目标之后，就要想办法实现它们。

小狗钱钱教给吉娅的办法之一是使用梦想相册和梦想储蓄罐：收集照片梦想相册用来收集和愿望有关的照片，并贴在梦想相册里。

每天看看相册

通过图片思考，幻想自己实现愿望的场景，这种行为称为“视觉化”。

准备一个梦想储蓄罐

每一个梦想各准备一个储蓄罐，将自己的梦想写上去。一旦储蓄罐准备好，就将省下的每一分钱存进去。

吉娅怀疑梦想相册会不会有效时，钱钱说：好奇是好的，但是绝不能让好奇阻碍你做事。太多的人做事犹豫不决，就是因为他们觉得没有完全弄懂这件事。真正付诸实践要比纯粹的思考有用多了。

当我们质疑这种幻想是不是“白日梦”时，我们需要知道，“成功的人之所以成功，就是因为他们一直梦想着自己成功的那一天，不停地想象着自己实现了梦想时的情形。当然，人不能停留在梦想里。”

“学习就是认识新观念和新想法的过程。假如人们始终以同一种思维方式来考虑问题的话，那么始终只会得到同样的结果。在我们还没有做之前，不要轻易下结论。

没有想象力的人是很难成就大事的。我们对一件事投入的精力越多，成功的可能性也越大。可是大多数人把精力放在自己并不喜欢的事情上，而不去想象自己希望得到的东西。”

不要抱着试试看的心态，而是去切实行动！如果你只是抱着试试看的心态，那么只会以失败告终，我们会一事无成。‘尝试’纯粹是一种借口，我们还没有做，就已经给自己想好了退路。不能试验，只有两个选择——做或者不做。”

成功日记

我们做一件事情时需要具备足够的自信心，我们的自信程度决定了我们是否相信自己的能力，是否相信自己。假如我们根本不相信自己能做到的话，那么我们就根本不会动手去做，而假如我们不开始去做，那么我们就什么也得不到。”

因此，我们需要做一本“成功日记”。“成功日记”类似于日记本，把所有做成功的事记录进去，每天至少写 5 条个人成果，任何小事都可以。这样做的主要目的是帮助我们增强自信心。

开始的时候也许我们会觉得不太容易，可能会问自己，这件或那件事情是否真的可以算作成果。在这种情况下，我们的回答应该是肯定的。过于自信比不够自信要好得多。”

当我们遇到问题时：

a、仍然要坚持自己的想法

一切正常的时候，每个人都能做到这一点。只有当真正的困难出现时才能见分晓。只有少数人能坚定不移地贯彻自己的计划。那些非常成功的人，甚至有能力在他们最困难的时候作出最杰出的表现。

b、进展顺利时

在一切进展非常顺利的情况下，也要坚定不移的贯彻自己的计划。

c、72 小时规定

当我们决定做一件事情时，我们必须在 72 小时内完成，否则我们很可能永远不会再做了。

“一个人挣钱的多少是和自己的自信心联系在一切的。另外，自己的经历究竟是集中在自己的能力范围之内，还是放到了自己的力所不能及的事情之外，这也是很重要的一点。没有成功日记本，我们就不会去思考自己适合在哪些方面赚钱。”

我们很多时候无法行动也是出于恐惧的心理，恐惧总是出现在我们设想事情会如何不顺的时候。我们对失败的可能性想得越多，就会越害怕。而当我们看着自己的成功日记时，我们就会注意到那些成功的事情，自然而然也就会想到应该怎样去做。”

挣钱和存钱

钱钱鼓励吉娅勇敢去赚钱时，讲了一个小男孩达瑞的故事。达瑞凭借个人努力在 17 岁成为百万富翁，因此成为了吉娅的精神榜样。

达瑞的故事里，一位商人告诉达瑞（吉娅的榜样）关于赚钱的建议：

  1. 想清楚喜欢什么，再想怎么赚钱。
  2. 为别人解决一个难题，那么你就能赚到很多钱；
  3. 把精力集中在你知道的、能做的和拥有的东西上。
  4. 买东西前可以询问“这个真的有必要吗？”

金先生在引导吉娅不要立刻花掉手中所有的钱时，讲了一只下金蛋的鹅的故事：

一个农夫养的鹅每天会下一个金蛋，农夫非常贪婪，希望这只鹅每天可以下至少两只金蛋，一气之下将鹅杀死了，从此再也得不到金蛋了。鹅是本金，金蛋就是利息，而农夫最大的错误就是不应“杀死”自己的“鹅”。

支出和收入是呈正比的，收入越高，支出越多，除非学会合理分配财产，学会量入为出。

针对陷入债务问题人的忠告：

a、毁掉所有的信用卡

使用信用卡时比使用现金花得钱多。

b、在许可范围内按最低的分期付款数目标准支付

分期付款额越高，每月剩下的生活费越少，很多时候低估了自己生活费之高，很可能在有大花费的时候再次贷款，用新贷还旧贷。

c、针对消费贷

除购房以外针对生活中商品如电视贷的款，首先最好是不申请。其次申请了，将扣除生活费后剩下的钱一半存起来，一半用于支付消费贷。

资金分配

作者建议，我们可以把我们的收入分为日常开销（10%）+梦想目标（40%）+金鹅账户（50%），也就是说我们可以把自己的收入 50%存起来，这笔钱不要轻易去动，他就像是前面所说的会下金蛋的鹅一样，可以钱生钱。

剩余的 50%当中除了我们需要的 10%的日常生活费以外，剩余的 40%存下来去实现我们自己想要实现的梦想，比如：买一个手机奖励自己，或者出去旅行等等。这个数字由自己支配，自己规划，记住要合理分配。

金鹅：来自下金蛋的故事，“鹅”指钱（储蓄值），“金蛋”指利息。

千万不要杀死你的鹅，不要把所有的钱都用于还贷款，让自己一无所有，一无所有不是我们的目标，我们的目标是实现最初定的 3 个愿望或者存储到钱。

睡后收入

投资注意点：

  1. 把钱投资在安全的地方。
  2. 钱应该下很多的“金蛋”（选择高利息，最高红利来自股票）。
  3. 投资应该简单明了，易于操作。

72 公式：

用 72 除以投资的年利润百分比，得到的数字就是这笔钱翻一倍所需要的年数。

用 72 除以一定的通货膨胀率，可以得出金钱在多少年以后会贬值一半。

在行情下跌时，只有实际卖出基金时，才会有损失。

基金有一个指标—浮动率：浮动率低安全性高，利润增长更稳定。基金一般 5 至 10 年，行情总有上升有下跌，总趋势上升，所以可以是 5 或 10 年后看下行情。

72/收益率=翻一倍的时间

72/通货膨胀率=贬值所用的时间

115 法则：115/收益率=翻两倍的时间

控制风险

现金要储备

You cannot invest all your money in stocks or funds. You should reserve some cash so that you have liquidity so that you can buy at the right time when the stock price drops. The remaining reserve cash can be invested in short-term income projects, such as daily discounts. Bank passbooks are just money-eating machines, and the benefits are less than the losses caused by inflation. Some savings types have high interest rates, but require cash to be stored in the bank for a relatively long time. Therefore, the author does not recommend the use of bank passbooks.

Money words

There are some people reading this who can’t listen to what you have to say, and nothing changes. Others start to manage money wisely after reading it, and they will have a happier and richer life.

item.title: Why would you risk storing so much money and gold in your home?
item.description: “There are many reasons.” The old lady explained to me, “First of all, because I sometimes like to hold these things in my hands and admire them. I like gold and banknotes very much.” I looked at her with disapproval and thought, I wonder if it is normal to like money in this way, and she admitted it so frankly… But then I recalled the day when Marcel and I looked at the contents of the box and counted them one by one. How pleasant it is when we touch the gold bars! Shouldn’t an old lady enjoy the same feeling of happiness when she opens a box? Besides, these things all belong to her. Mrs. Tao Mu continued: “Secondly, this amount of money is reserved for emergencies. No matter what happens, the things I put in the box will always be enough for me to spend for several years.” “That’s too much!” I said with a smile. “It depends on how much money you have in total,” Mrs. Taomu explained. “It makes no sense to keep more than 10% of your total property in cash at home.” I whistled softly. This old lady must be very rich. “Third, I invested a large part of my money in stocks, which involves certain risks. Therefore, it is wise to keep at least some of my money on hand. I will explain this to you when I have the opportunity.”

item.title: The eternal winter of the stock exchange.
item.description: The first time the stock market crashed, I had exactly the same reaction as you. I hated myself for buying these stocks, and I was very worried that the market would continue to fall. At this time, newspapers are full of pessimistic predictions, saying that this is the beginning of a world economic crisis and an eternal winter for the stock exchange.

item.title: Mr. Jin always calls the bank book a "money-eating machine."
What should we do if the market continues to fall?
item.description: So you’d better not invest too much money. And if the market does continue to fall, wouldn’t it be better if you still have money on hand to buy again?

item.title: Marcel once thought about selling the fund in his hand. He said this was called withdrawing profits.
item.description: Mrs. Tao Mu asked him what he planned to do with the money and how to let it continue to grow. We came to the conclusion: choose the same fund for investment again. Marcel immediately realized that there was no point in selling the fund now.

item.title: money quotes about money money
item.description:
1. Money has some secrets and laws. If you want to understand these secrets and laws, the prerequisite is that you must really have this desire.
  2. If you just have a try mentality, you will only end up failing and you will accomplish nothing.
  3. Trying is an excuse. Before you do it, you have already thought of a way out for yourself.
  4. You can’t experiment, you only have two choices, do it or not do it.
  5. The most critical factor in whether you can make money is not whether you have a good idea.
  6. How smart you are is not the main reason. The determining factor is your confidence.
  7. You need to figure out what your interests are, and then think about how to make money from it.
  8. You have to do things that are of great significance to your future every day without interruption.
  9. You won’t spend more than 10 minutes doing this, but those 10 minutes will make all the difference.
  10. People who are in debt should cancel all credit cards.
  11. Loans should be repaid as much as possible.
  12. You should save half of the money you don’t use for living and use the other half to pay off debts.
  13. It’s best not to apply for a consumer loan at all.
  14. Ask yourself every time before borrowing money: “Is this really necessary?” When you set a big goal, it means that you have to work much harder than others.
  15. Poverty makes people more miserable.
  16. If I didn’t have my goose, I would always have to work to make money.
  17. But once I have a “goose”, my “money” automatically works for me.
  18. Luck is really just the result of adequate preparation and hard work.
  19. Money only stays with those who work hard for it.
  20. People who obtain ill-gotten wealth through illegal means will feel worse than when they have no money.
  21. Fear always arises when we imagine how things will go wrong.
  22. The more we think about the possibility of failure, the more afraid we become.
  23. And when you think towards positive goals, you won’t be afraid.
  24. Every time winter passes, spring comes, then summer, and every summer is followed by autumn, and then winter again, and so on every year.
  25. Just like the changes in nature, there are always changes of seasons in the exchange, and the cycle goes back and forth.
  26. If you don’t do what you do today, you will never know what you can write after putting some pressure on yourself.
  27. The things a person is most proud of are the things that are the hardest to do.

item.title: My friend Monica’s parents’ financial situation is getting better and better?
item.description: Soon I turned 12. Everything remains the same, we still don’t go on vacation to the beach. Mom and Dad still kept saying that the business was affected by the “recession.” What they mean is that the domestic economic situation is the root cause of their financial problems. But I have a question, why are my friend Monica’s parents’ financial situation getting better and better under the same economic situation?
